Cc: support@kairosprocure.com

Subject: Kairos supplier portal invite failing — SSO redirects back to login

Hi Diego,

We received the Coupa invite that Redwood sent for our account but our users can’t finish onboarding. When they click the invite link, they get routed to our IdP (Okta) and after signing in the page lands back at the Redwood portal home (no claim accepted) and shows an error: "Claim token stale / 401".

Steps we tried:
- Open link in Chrome incognito (same behavior)
- Clear cookies and try again (same)
- Use the invite from a different machine (same)

We captured a screenshot and a session trace (attached). Useful IDs in the trace: correlation=8f3a-cc12, claim=clr-20261117-7b2. Timestamp: 2026-11-17T17:03:22Z.

Can you advise? We need to complete onboarding today — we have a PO pending and AP is waiting on the supplier record.

Attachments: invite_screenshot.png, session_trace_1662.txt

Thanks,
Sasha Cole

Hi Sasha — thanks for the details and the attachments. I’m looping in Ben (on infra) and Naomi (CS) so we can triage.

Quick ask while we investigate: can you confirm whether your Okta team sees any failed SAML assertions around correlation id 8f3a-cc12? If you can paste the raw relaystate value from the assertion that would help.

Initial checks we’ll run on our side:
- Verify invite claim TTL and whether the claim was marked consumed at our gateway
- Inspect relaystate encoding and cookie domain on the redirect path
- Reissue the invite for a fresh claim and confirm behaviour

Temporary workaround (please try and report back): if you open the reinvite link I’ll send, and complete in a new browser profile, does that change anything? I’ll also attach a short troubleshooting page (reinvite_link.html) with steps and a browser console snippet.

Ben/Naomi: assigning INF-4521 (link below) to start a quick replay and to check whether our auth proxy rewrote the relaystate or truncated the Referer header. Ben, can you also validate if the gateway cache may have returned an old claim mapping?

We’ll aim to get this resolved within the hour.

Diego Fernandez
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
diego@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sasha Cole <sasha@kairosprocure.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kairos supplier portal invite failing — SSO redirects back to login

Diego / Naomi — I ran a quick replay against the logs for correlation=8f3a-cc12. Findings:
- Our gateway shows the claim was issued at 2026-11-17T17:03:20Z and a subsequent POST from the IdP returned a 302 back to the portal, but the relaystate payload in that POST was truncated to 256 bytes (we expect up to ~512). Truncation happened before the base64 payload end, which likely makes the claim lookup fail and the system treats it as stale.
- The Referer header in the IdP POST is present but short; I suspect our proxy (nginx) had a rewrite rule that chopped cookie+relaystate when the request went through our auth layer.
- No evidence the claim was consumed successfully; it seems the lookup fails and claim remains unused.

Action plan:
1) Short-term: resend a fresh invite (Diego) with a claim TTL bump to 15 minutes and ask Kairos to use the reinvite in a private window.
2) Medium: deploy a one-line nginx rule to preserve full body length for the auth POST (INF-4521 on Jira). I’ll prepare a PR and a canary deploy to a staging gateway; should be low risk.
3) Postmortem: confirm whether tenant-specific cookie domain caused the truncation path; if so we’ll add an integration test for relaystate sizes.

Sasha: if you’re OK I can escalate the replay to our Coupa integration partner for extra insight — they may have seen similar relaystate truncation with certain Okta proxies. Give me the green light and I’ll share the log snippet.

Attached: session_trace_1662.txt (redacted).

—Ben
Senior Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Kairos supplier portal invite failing — SSO redirects back to login

Thanks Diego / Ben — appreciate the quick triage.

We tried the reinvite you sent from Diego in a private window and it worked for two of our users. One user still saw the old behavior but after clearing a local proxy cache on their corporate laptop it worked too. So behaviour matches your diagnosis (truncated relaystate + local cache causing stale mapping).

OK to escalate to your Coupa partner — please share the redacted logs. Also please confirm when the nginx rule is live so we can close our internal ticket.

I’ve attached a final success screenshot. Thanks for the fast help — we can now proceed with PO 2026-KAI-3345.
